project.name: Fortress
project.description: A reference implementation of the Fortress programming language.

target.name: help
target.echo:
Targets include: clean - clean out everything cleanCache - clean out cached Fortress bytecodes and ASTs systemProperties - report Java system properties
compile - build the Fortress system compileCommon - build the subset of the Fortress system necessary for generated files generated - create all machine-generated files
test - run all tests. Includes compile This is the pre-push tests. testOnly - together with -DtestPattern='SomeTestName' runs only the junit test in class (not package) SomeTestName, e.g., -DtestPattern='SyntaxAbstractionJUTest' testQuick - only compiler tests, other compiler tests, library tests testFast - a subset of tests, excluding (some) slower ones "test" depends on this, so it should not be modified carelessly. testDemos - test the Fortress demos
Other targets: checkEnv, checkNodesUptodate, checkOperatorsUptodate, checkParserUptodate, compileJava, compileAll, compileCommonLint, compileLint, doc, grammarCoverage, help, init, interpreter-jar, makeAST, operatorsGen, fortressparser, preparser, parser, reportNotPassing, testAll, testCompiler, testSystem, testOtherCompiler, testCruiseControl
